source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.19 with Figure 10.11 and the sample problem, printed pages 235-236.

blocks.text: Silver/silver ion electrode aur copper/copper(II) ion electrode se bane cell ke liye reaction Cu(s) + 2Ag+(aq) se Cu2+(aq) + 2Ag(s), E standard = +0.46 V hai. E cell ko silver ion concentration ke logarithm ke muqable plot karne se Figure 10.11 ka graph milta hai: silver ion concentration barhana E cell ko zyada musbat karta hai. E cell par concentration aur darja hararat ka asar Nernst ke muadle se milta hai; kisi electrode ke liye, jaise Cu(s)/Cu2+(aq), E = E standard + (RT / zF) ln([oxidised shakal] / [reduced shakal]), jahan E ghair-standard halaat mein electrode potential, E standard standard electrode potential, R gas constant 8.314 J K-1 mol-1, T kelvin darja hararat, z muntaqil electrons ki tadaad, F Faraday constant C mol-1 mein, ln natural logarithm, aur [oxidised] aur [reduced] half-equation mein oxidised aur reduced shaklon ki concentrations hain.

blocks.alt: E cell / V (0 se 0.5) ka log [Ag+] (-8 se 0) ke muqable graph. Seedhi lakeer log [Ag+] = -7.8 ke qareeb 0 V se log [Ag+] = 0 par 0.46 V tak charhti hai, jahan teer use E standard cell batata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.11: Cell reaction mein silver ions ki concentration barhana (kitab ki Figure 10.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Metal/metal ion electrode ke liye muadla saada ho jata hai: ln x = 2.303 log10 x, aur standard darja hararat par R, T aur F mustaqil hain, to E = E standard + (0.059 / z) log([oxidised shakal] / [reduced shakal]).

blocks.title: Nernst ka muadla
blocks.text: E = E standard + (RT / zF) ln([oxidised] / [reduced]), ya 298 K par E = E standard + (0.059 / z) log([oxidised] / [reduced]).
Sample problem: 0.1 M Zn2+ mein zinc

0.1 M Zn2+ ions ke solution mein zinc electrode ka electrode potential kya hai, Zn2+/Zn ka E standard = -0.76 V diya hua? Zn2+ + 2e- se Zn istemal karte hue: E = -0.76 + (8.31 x 298 / (2 x 96500)) ln(0.1) = -0.76 + (-0.029) = -0.79 V (print -0.78 V deti hai). Chunke Zn2+ concentration ghati hai equilibrium peechhe shift hota hai aur electrode potential ghat-ta hai.

blocks.prompt: Nernst ka muadla aur us ki ahmiyat bayan karein, aur 0.01 M Cu2+ mein copper electrode ka potential nikalein, E standard +0.34 V (Quick Check 10.9a, d).
blocks.explanation: E = E standard + (0.059 / z) log([oxidised] / [reduced]); yeh miqdari taur par batata hai ke standard halaat se hat kar concentration aur darja hararat ke saath electrode ya cell potential kaise badalta hai. Cu2+ + 2e- se Cu ke liye: E = +0.34 + (0.059 / 2) log(0.01) = +0.34 + 0.0295 x (-2) = +0.34 - 0.059 = +0.28 V.

items: Nernst: E = E0 + (RT/zF) ln([ox]/[red]) = 298 K par E0 + (0.059/z) log([ox]/[red]); Cu + 2Ag+ (E0 +0.46 V) ka E cell log[Ag+] ke saath barhta hai.
0.1 M Zn2+ mein Zn: E = -0.76 + 0.0128 ln 0.1 = -0.79 V (print -0.78): kam ion concentration, zyada manfi E.
